title: Sourcing clothing from Turkey – what should a European brand confirm before dispatch?
seoTitle: Sourcing Clothing from Turkey for European Brands
description: Plan an apparel shipment from Istanbul to a European warehouse. Name the parties, documents, receiving arrangements and approval milestones for the real route.
author: BEWE4R team
intro: For a European brand sourcing garments from Turkey, planning should end at the receiving warehouse. A sample approved in Istanbul, a carton collected by a carrier and stock accepted by a warehouse are separate milestones. Define all three in the order so the production team and the launch team work towards the same event.

toc.text: Identify the parties behind the place names
Agree a handover that can be checked
Check the warehouse requirements while you can still change the pack
What if the delivery warehouse changes after sampling?
Keep dispatch and availability separate in the launch plan

bodyHtml:
Identify the parties behind the place names

A Dutch brand can have its buying team in Amsterdam, garment production in Turkey and a fulfilment partner in Germany. Give the supplier the actual destination, warehouse contact and receiving requirements. Identify who will confirm the manufacturing locations and origin documentation for the particular garments. The country of the brand or of dispatch alone does not settle every origin question.

Agree a handover that can be checked

BeforeHave this in writing
SamplingDelivery address, named receiver and which colour, size and version are travelling
Bulk releaseApproved garment, specification, quantity matrix and unresolved items
CollectionShipping arrangement, named place, document owner, carton count and carrier contact
Warehouse receiptBooking window, inbound reference, carton markings and process for discrepancies

Ask your freight provider or customs adviser to check the documentation for the product, origin and destination. EU and UK destinations have different import arrangements. For EU routes, the European Commission explains the scope of the EU–Türkiye customs union. Treat the actual shipment and its paperwork as the basis for a decision. European Commission information on EU–Türkiye trade

Check the warehouse requirements while you can still change the pack

One warehouse may accept mixed cartons with a clear contents sheet. Another may require each carton to hold a single SKU and carry a booked-in reference. Passing that requirement to the manufacturer after cartons are sealed creates avoidable handling. Send an example carton label during packing approval and ask the warehouse to check it.

What if the delivery warehouse changes after sampling?

Reconfirm the receiver, destination, routing responsibilities and carton instructions before packing begins. A new warehouse may require different inbound labels or bookings even within the same country. Have the party responsible for shipping establish whether the change affects any documents, then send the revised details to the maker and the person accepting the shipment.

Keep dispatch and availability separate in the launch plan

If the carrier confirms collection on Tuesday, the goods still need to arrive and pass the warehouse intake check. Tell the shop team which event makes stock available for orders. If receipt shows a mismatch, use the packing list and carton identifiers to establish which variants are affected before releasing the rest.

See BEWE4R’s delivery information and send the receiving destination and target in-warehouse date with your garment brief. The team can then discuss the route for that project.
